indexes_at_measurement.indexdef: CREATE INDEX idx_qbudget_items_order ON olist.order_items USING btree (order_id) INCLUDE (price, product_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_qbudget_items_seller ON olist.order_items USING btree (seller_id, order_id) INCLUDE (price)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_items_pk ON olist.order_items USING btree (order_id, order_item_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_qbudget_payments_plan ON olist.order_payments USING btree (order_id, payment_type, payment_installments) INCLUDE (payment_value)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_payments_pk ON olist.order_payments USING btree (order_id, payment_sequential)
CREATE INDEX idx_qbudget_reviews_latest ON olist.order_reviews USING btree (order_id, review_answer_timestamp DESC, review_creation_date DESC, review_id DESC) INCLUDE (review_score)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_reviews_pk ON olist.order_reviews USING btree (review_id, order_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_pkey ON olist.orders USING btree (order_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX products_pkey ON olist.products USING btree (product_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sellers_pkey ON olist.sellers USING btree (seller_id)
